key.name: tasks
key.description: The calendar menu lists the tasks due today and the overdue ones, from Notes while it is open and unlocked.

key.name: weather
key.description: The weather beside the clock and in the calendar menu, for the place chosen in Weather. It sends that place to the weather services GNOME uses.

key.name: getting-set
key.description: For an account's first four weeks, the calendar menu lists a few steps that protect the machine and make it yours, each ticked by what the machine already says. Hide turns this off.
